parameters.content:
Attach credentials before activating. No model is used.

List Firefly bills: Header Auth. Header name Authorization, value Bearer <Firefly personal access token>.

CalDAV requests: Basic Auth. User is the Nextcloud username. Password is a CalDAV app password. Leave the PROPFIND method expression as it is.

The Nextcloud calendar must be named Payments. Each event stores the amount, next date, and Firefly id.
